title: manuscript-review (Enceladus k_eff manuscript)
summary: Reviews the main text of the Enceladus k_eff manuscript in two rounds, using only the manuscript, the papers it cites and published style authorities: no memory, notes, outline or earlier reviews reach any agent. Round 1 checks content: every citation instance is checked against the cited paper's pages, citation practice is summarized (Molaro et al. 2019 first), terms are compared with the field's usage, and repetition is condensed. Round 2 checks spelling and grammar in American English on the revised text.

Readers (Sonnet) find; checkers (Opus) judge from page images without the readers' reasoning; scripts check quotes, preserved numbers and citations, and compilation. A planted-error calibration gates the run. The user decides every finding at U2 and U3, and the original files are never overwritten.
status: Revision 2 (7 agent roles), design for review, 2026-10-26. Nothing built; open decisions in WORKFLOW.md §9.

nodes.title: U0 Supply manuscript
nodes.job: Uploads the Overleaf export (zip) of the current manuscript.
details: Abstract, key points, appendices out of scope

nodes.title: M1 parse_manuscript.py
nodes.job: Splits the LaTeX into sentences with stable IDs and lists every citation instance (one sentence citing one work).
details: Out-of-scope sections marked; nothing downstream sees them
Unknown structure: stop and ask the user

nodes.title: sentences.jsonl, citations.jsonl
nodes.job: Sentence ID, file, line, text; citation instances; bibliography; math, labels and numbers per sentence.

nodes.title: M2 check_bib.py
nodes.job: Resolves every bibliography entry in Crossref and compares its metadata; finds retractions, missing DOIs, unused and missing keys.
details: Problems become findings for U2

nodes.title: bib_report.json
nodes.job: Per entry: resolved record, metadata differences, retraction status.

nodes.title: M3 acquire.py
nodes.job: Matches each cited work to a PDF by the DOI or title on its first page.
details: Shared with the lunar literature-review design

nodes.title: U1 Supply missing papers
nodes.job: Drops in PDFs from the fetch list, or marks a work unavailable.
details: Unavailable: its citations reported as not checked

nodes.title: M4 prepare.py
nodes.job: Renders page images and 300 dpi tiles and runs Marker on every page of every cited paper.
details: A failed page cannot be cited as evidence

nodes.title: pages/, tiles/, marker/
nodes.job: Page images, tiles and Marker text per cited paper, with hashes.

nodes.title: C0 calibrate.py (before the real run)
nodes.job: Runs every track on a manuscript copy with 40+ planted errors (10+ written by the user) and 10+ controls.
details: Gates F, P, T, R and L
Single long-context model run as baseline
Rerun after any prompt, schema or model change

nodes.title: calibration.json
nodes.job: Catch rate per error kind, false alarms on controls, baseline comparison.

nodes.title: F1 morty-evidence-finder
nodes.job: Reads one cited paper and finds the passages that support each manuscript sentence citing it, with caveats.
details: Fresh per paper
Flags passages that credit another work (secondary citation)
Or: not found, with sections searched

nodes.title: F2 check_quotes.py
nodes.job: Checks every quote is 8+ words, found on its page in the Marker text and unique in the paper.
details: Failure: F3 told, with the page images

nodes.title: F3 beth-citation-checker
nodes.job: Judges the manuscript sentence itself against the evidence pages as images: supported, partly, not supported or background only.
details: Fresh per citation instance
Compares every number and unit
No Marker text, no F1 reasoning
Proposes a minimal corrected sentence

nodes.title: verdicts.json
nodes.job: One verdict per citation instance, with the quote, page and reason.

nodes.title: F4 beth-citation-checker (full read)
nodes.job: Searches the whole paper again when F1 found nothing.
details: Still not found: U2 as not supported
search_corpus.py lists other cited papers that state it

nodes.title: P1 citation_stats.py
nodes.job: Counts each work's citations by section, share, sole citations, consecutive runs and repeats within a paragraph.

nodes.title: P2 beth-citation-advisor
nodes.job: Recommends keep, drop as repeat, cite the primary source, or add a cocitation for each use of heavily cited works.
details: Molaro et al. (2019) first
Primary sources only if named in the cited paper
New citations must pass F1 to F3

nodes.title: citation_guidance.md
nodes.job: Per-instance recommendations and a summary per heavily cited work.

nodes.title: T1 term_inventory.py
nodes.job: Finds variant forms by rule: hyphenation, capitals, British spellings, acronyms, symbols and units.

nodes.title: T2 corpus_usage.py
nodes.job: Counts each term form in the text of every cited paper, by journal and year.
details: Measures the field's usage, not the manuscript's

nodes.title: T3 beth-term-judge
nodes.job: Groups term variants into concepts and recommends a standard form from corpus counts and saved style authorities.
details: AGU style guide, Fierz 2009, IUPAC, SI brochure
Quoted rules checked; counts filled in by script
No evidence: labeled preference only

nodes.title: style_sheet.md
nodes.job: Adopted terms, spellings and hyphenation, each with its evidence.

nodes.title: R1 repetition.py
nodes.job: Finds overlapping sentences and paragraphs, repeated phrases and filler phrases.

nodes.title: R2 beth-concision-editor
nodes.job: Proposes deletions, merges and shortenings for one section, naming where each deleted fact remains.
details: Fresh per section; sees the whole manuscript

nodes.title: R3 check_rewrites.py
nodes.job: Checks every citation key, number, unit, label and equation survives each rewrite.
details: Failure: back to R2 once, then dropped

nodes.title: R4 beth-meaning-checker
nodes.job: Compares original and rewrite only: same meaning, information lost or meaning changed.
details: Fresh per proposal; never sees the reason

nodes.title: U2 Decide round 1
nodes.job: Accepts, rejects or edits each content finding in review.html, with page images for citations.
details: All non-supported verdicts; supported: census or 60 sample
Sample error: F3 revised, C0 and F3 rerun

nodes.title: review.html
nodes.job: Every finding with original, suggestion, evidence, verdict and a decision control.

nodes.title: X1 apply_edits.py
nodes.job: Applies the accepted round 1 changes to a copy, compiles it and makes a latexdiff PDF.
details: Changed citing sentences go back through F2 and F3
Overlaps shown to the user

nodes.title: manuscript v1
nodes.job: Revised .tex copy and latexdiff v0 to v1. The original is never overwritten.

nodes.title: L1 spellcheck.py
nodes.job: Flags hunspell en_US misses, British forms and words spelled two ways, and applies the style sheet.

nodes.title: L2 morty-copyeditor
nodes.job: Proposes spelling, grammar and punctuation edits for one section, given the L1 flags.
details: Fresh per section
No style rewriting

nodes.title: L3 check_edits.py
nodes.job: Checks each edit's original span exists and leaves math, keys, labels and numbers untouched.

nodes.title: U3 Decide round 2
nodes.job: Accepts or rejects every copyedit that passed L3, grouped by rule so one rule can be accepted at once.

nodes.title: X2 apply_edits.py
nodes.job: Applies round 2, compiles, and writes the final latexdiff PDFs and report.

nodes.title: manuscript v2 + report
nodes.job: Final .tex copy, latexdiff v0 to v2, decisions, manifest.
